note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a BLZ 10(1), 17(1); A06b BLZ 10(1), 17(1); L05 Const 27, BLZ 21(1)(f)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: No provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: Generally applicable provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory unconditionally; by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad (the dataset codes no separate descent rule for a child born in the country, birth there giving it; the parent's sex is read from mode A01b). Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Immigration and Nationality Department, Belize, Citizenship: Do I Qualify. It confirmed the years of residence and descent. It was silent on renunciation, loss on taking another citizenship and birth in the territory, which still rest on the sources above, re-read that day and found the same.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Belize, 2024
sources.said: Person has been ordinarily resident in Belize for 5 years immediately prior to the application, and intends to continue to do so. ... n.a. ... Person is a citizen otherwise than by birth or descent who acquires citizenship of another country. ... No provision ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born abroad to a citizen. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Belize unless the child is born to a foreign diplomat and neither parent is a citizen, or one of the parents is an enemy alien and the child is born in a place then under occupation by the enemy. ... No provision

sources.title: Immigration and Nationality Department, Belize, Citizenship: Do I Qualify
sources.said: Citizenship for Permanent Residence Holders You have been a holder of Permanent Residence for a minimum of 5 years. You have been resident continuously in Belize, this means that upon being granted Permanent Residency you have not resided outside Belize for periods that exceed thirty consecutive days or accumulate to a total of three months in any twelve month period. ... You were born outside of Belize and one of your parents is a Citizen of Belize.
